user.title: Club logos
user.description:
This integration loads its data from data.sihf.ch, the undocumented statistics interface behind sihf.ch. It is not affiliated with the SIHF or the National League.

The club logos are the property of the clubs. If you allow it, they are downloaded once from sihf.ch and stored locally in your Home Assistant, for your own dashboards only. Without consent the cards show the club abbreviation instead.
